text:
maria (partnerships): Hey team — Zenith just dropped Q3 supply inputs. They included reserved-tenor windows, spot eviction histograms, and a weird bucketed availability CSV. I put the file in partnerships/zenith/q3_supply_raw.csv. Need cost-model-ready numbers by EOD Wed.

jon (finance): Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) price ladder per SKU (USD/hr) for reserved vs spot, 2) minimum commit increments (e.g., 100 GPU-hours). Without those we can't simulate amortized cost.

suresh (procurement): They also included marketplace fees (one-time listing + percent share). I asked them to break out marketplace vs direct sales discounts.

kevin (infra-ops): Important: the spot eviction file is a per-hour time-to-evict histogram. We should convert to a survival curve (prob no-evict by t minutes). Propose we extract p95, median, and mean time-to-evict and a tail probability for >30m.

li (eng-ml): For model-serving cost sims we also need eviction correlation with sequence length (short vs long tokens) — if they can't give that, at least give eviction during high-memory workloads. Can we request KV-cache pressure buckets?

vendor-sync-bot: Zenith uploaded: https://zenith.supply/q3_supply_raw.csv (5.4MB) + availability_heatmap.png + reserved_ratecard_v2.xlsx. Notes: reserved discounts tiered by 1/3/6/12 mo; spot preemption policy: 2-min graceful shutdown + 15s pre-notify.

maria (partnerships): Good. @jon @kevin @li I'd like a minimal schema we can hand back to Zen for canonical fields. Suggested CSV header snippet:

```
sku,timestamp,region,availability_pct,spot_eviction_histogram,reserved_tiers,min_commit_hours,marketplace_fee_pct
```

kevin (infra-ops): That looks fine. Add `grace_period_seconds` and `eviction_pre_notify_seconds`. Also add `typical_batch_seq_len_bucket` if vendor can provide.

jon (finance): Also include `list_price_usd_per_hr` and `reserved_effective_usd_per_hr` for each tier so we can compute blended unit cost.

maria (partnerships): I'll send the schema to Zenith and ask for p50/p95/tail(>30m) for evictions, plus an availability time-series for last 90 days. Can someone take the ask to vendor and track? @suresh?

suresh (procurement): I'll own the ask. I'll push for CSV with daily granularity + sample of raw logs for 48hr window if possible.

li (eng-ml): For the cost model we should also request a synthetic workload run: 1M tokens/day baseline, two seq length patterns (short/long). That helps recommend quantization/instance mixes. Not required but would be ideal.

vendor-sync-bot: Zenith reply (excerpt): "We can provide 90-day availability series, p50/p95 eviction times, and sample pod logs for a 48hr window. We cannot map evictions to token-level seq length by default but can run a targeted test for a 48hr synthetic workload (extra charge)."

jon (finance): If Zenith charges for the synthetic test, estimate whether it's worth it: what is delta in unit cost if evictions shift p95 from 10m -> 5m? We can simulate both and see sensitivity.

kevin (infra-ops): I'll run sensitivity sims once we have p50/p95. Quick note on modeling: treat spot preemptions as a renewal-process with measured survival curve, and model fallback latency to reserved variants (time to spin new reserved pod) — that affects effective lost tokens.

maria (partnerships): Plan:
- Suresh to collect canonical CSV and pricing ladder (owner)
- Kevin + Li run sensitivity sims on p50/p95 & fallback windows (owners)
- Jon produce finance sheet with blended unit-cost outputs and show commit break-even points
- I'll coordinate messaging for marketplace listing (if fees change modeling) and flag if we need legal for announcement language.

suresh (procurement): Got it. I'll ping Zenith now and ask for the schema we drafted. ETA: Tue noon.

li (eng-ml): Heads-up: when you send schema, include an example row so vendors map fields correctly. Example:

`g5x.large,2026-08-10T00:00Z,us-west-2,0.997,"{0:10000,60:500}","1mo:0.8,3mo:0.7",100,5`

jon (finance): Great. Once we have Zenith's ladder I'll populate the break-even model. If anyone sees weird discounts (e.g., >40% baseline), flag for legal/partner ops.

maria (partnerships): Thanks all. Suresh — once you have the CSV link drop it here and I'll schedule a 30m sync with Zenith for clarifications. :calendar: :thumbsup:

vendor-sync-bot: Zenith uploaded the canonical CSV: https://zenith.supply/q3_supply_canonical.csv — includes reserved_tiers, evictions_p50,p95,grace_period_seconds.

kevin (infra-ops): Received. I'll start converting the eviction histogram -> survival curve and run a quick sensitivity by EOD.

maria (partnerships): Perfect. Closing loop: we should avoid public announcement until we lock marketplace fee and commit language. Will coordinate with marketing once finance confirms break-even.

jon (finance): Noted. Will have initial blended unit-cost deck by Wed COB.

suresh (procurement): Zenith synced on call; they confirmed minimum commit increments are 100 GPU-hours and marketplace listing fee is $1k one-time + 6% revenue share for reserved listings. Dropping the updated CSV link in the channel.

maria (partnerships): Awesome — thanks everyone.
